props.covers: The layout-agent harness's structural rules: filename-convention tool discovery, side-effect-free registration with per-spawn runtime binding, the catalog/service seam, single-source rosters, one-way outward edges, and where craft numbers live.

text.insert: The layout-agent harness: board math, the model-facing catalog, the session service, and the run viewer. What the agent can do (tools, session lifecycle, perception) is owned by design. This area records the registration seam and the placement rules that keep the registered surface honest.

Design knowledge and session behavior have separate owners. The shared topics explain visual patterns, multi-zoom composition, containment, and vocabulary. The system prompt owns core philosophy directly after purpose and depth assessment as its own phase. The prompt now applies the behavioral reference through orientate, assess_depth, understand, map_patterns, build_sections, render_validate, and finalize phases using the live state and Canvas tools at each step. Shape and color facts derive from the object-preference registry. The system prompt owns the quality checklist as success criteria. It links physical review questions to active lint rules without treating an automated pass as proof of conceptual quality.

Changes to shared guidance and its vocabulary dependencies are included in evaluation style fingerprints. Core philosophy and the quality checklist are canonical Prompt Kit content covered by the prompt fingerprint.

Text fit answers in three states, and every answer the harness cannot promise becomes a note, which never blocks finalize. A definite overflow still blocks, even when the text holds uncovered characters.

Findings are errors, warnings, or notes, numbered E1, W1, and N1 onward. The clipped-text rule warns only on a definite overflow, and the unreadable-labels and covered-content rules warn only on a reliable chip with 1 px of slack.

Within 1 px of a box edge the browser can wrap either way, and characters the bundled faces lack paint in per-machine fallback fonts.
Finalize blocks on every error and warning in the edited scope, so a guess filed as a warning would refuse a commit over one pixel.
